objects.name: Analytic 2156
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a process opening a raw socket or executing tcpdump/tshark on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux asset's network interface, from a User Identifier (UID) that does not normally perform packet capture. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): raw socket creation (SOCK_RAW) or tcpdump/tshark execution by uid not in authorized capture User Identifiers (UIDs)

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Accounts with documented network analysis/diagnostic responsibilities.
Allowlist of approved packet capture tools and processes that legitimately load capture drivers.
